text:
By Sarthak Khanna ,
55 minutes ago
Jailton Almeida (Image Credits: Imagn) The UFC heavyweight division was rocked after reports surfaced that Jailton Almeida has been released from the promotion. The No. 8-ranked contender, who compiled an 8-3 record inside the Octagon, is reportedly out following back-to-back losses to Alexander Volkov and Rizvan Kuniev. The news, first reported by Laerte Viana, quickly made waves across social media.
Almeida entered the UFC with significant hype and was demanding a fight against Ciryl Gane lately. A dominant grappler with suffocating top control, ‚ÄúMalhadinho‚Äù was once viewed as a serious dark horse in the heavyweight title picture. His early run through the division showcased his ability to overwhelm opponents on the mat, often making seasoned heavyweights look helpless once the fight hit the canvas.
However, momentum in the heavyweight division can shift quickly. Losses to Volkov and Kuniev appeared to stall his climb, raising questions about his ceiling against elite competition. While some fighters are given time to rebuild, the UFC‚Äôs decision suggests the promotion saw limited upside moving forward ‚Äî at least in the current landscape of the division.
The reaction online, however, has been far more unforgiving.
Fans Tear Into Jailton Almeida After Shock UFC Exit Jailton Almeida (Image Credits: Imagn) Within minutes of the news breaking, MMA fans flooded comment sections with blunt takes. Some labeled the move ‚Äúlong overdue,‚Äù while others went even further, calling Almeida ‚Äúthe worst fighter ever‚Äù in exaggerated frustration. A person commented, ‚ÄúGood riddance. He is boring af, shitting up the sport.‚Äù
Another comment was, ‚Äúhe‚Äôs a shitter but that seems a bit harsh, he‚Äôd beat up the jobbers ranked lower than him faster than everyone else ranked there.‚Äù
‚ÄúHe literally did not bother trying to fight in his last 2 fights. Dude probably fixing fights and making money off it,‚Äù a comment read.
‚ÄúLook at his size compared to the people he lost to smh,‚Äù a fan commented.
‚ÄúWow. Bro got cooked and was cut,‚Äù an X user wrote.
‚ÄúAnyone who performs like that should be cut. Hope they apply it across the board. Engage or go somewhere else,‚Äù one fan wrote.
‚ÄúGood worst fighter ever,‚Äù a netizen wrote.
One comment read, ‚ÄúOne of the only heavyweights in shape on the roster. Not sure what the grand plan is here.‚Äù
For better or worse, the heavyweight division moves fast ‚Äî and in the eyes of many fans, Jailton Almeida‚Äôs time had simply run out.
